title: USB Audio Out (tracks, MAIN, CUE)
author: irpina
description: The Octatrack as a 20-channel USB audio input (UAC2, 44.1 kHz, 24-bit) on its own USB port, as a function of usb-ot: tracks 1-8 post-FX before their level on channels 1-16, MAIN on 17-18 and CUE on 19-20 at high speed; the tracks' stereo sum at full speed. It combines with USB MIDI. Built on what sambanks/octabam's USB audio found (the taps, the MAIN and CUE alignment, the rate servo, the first poll's cushion).
